subject: world_language
concept: Debating a topic persuasively, using appropriate connecting and argumentative language in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'sustained argumentation' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences debate-turn cards using target-language argumentative connecting phrases
exercise.abstract: Student performs a short persuasive debate turn in the target language, using appropriate argumentative language

assessment.mastery_threshold: debate turn uses at least two argumentative connecting phrases appropriately
misconception_flags: presents an opinion with no argumentative connecting language linking reasons together

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
